landing.subtitle: Peyo's business validation service. Forms are accessed by invitation and analysts review each request from the panel.

auth.heroBody: Invite your clients, receive their documents and validate every business from one panel.
auth.point1Body: Each request arrives through a unique link, no account needed for the applicant.
auth.point2Body: Identity, AML and company registry checks with DIDIT.
auth.point3Body: Each organization only sees its own keys, forms and requests.
auth.forbidden: Your account doesn't have access to the panel. If you think this is a mistake, contact the administrator.
auth.passwordUpdated: Password updated. You can sign in now.
auth.forgotSubtitle: We'll email you a link to choose a new one.

auth.confirmRecoveryBody: Click continue to choose your new password.
auth.confirmInviteBody: Click continue to choose your password and enter the panel.
auth.confirmEmailBody: Click continue to confirm your email change.
auth.confirmEmailPendingBody: You confirmed from this address. To finish the change, also open the link sent to the other one.

auth.errEmailRateLimit: Too many emails were sent. Wait a while before requesting another.
auth.errBanned: This account is disabled. Contact the administrator.
auth.errWeakPassword: The password is too weak: check the requirements.
auth.errSamePassword: The new password must be different from the current one.
auth.errNeedsMfa: First verify your two-factor authentication code.
auth.errMfaCode: Wrong code. Check your authenticator app.
auth.errMfaExpired: The code expired. Try a new one.
auth.errLinkExpired: The link expired. Request a new one.
auth.errSessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
auth.errEmailTaken: That email is already in use.
auth.errGeneric: Something went wrong. Try again in a few minutes.
auth.mfaSubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app for {email}.

auth.resetMfaSubtitle: Your account has two-step verification: enter the code before choosing the new password.
auth.errWrongPortal: This account can't sign in here. Use the sign-in page your administrator gave you.
auth.errEmailNotConfirmed: Your account isn't activated yet: ask the administrators to resend your access.
auth.suspendedBody: Your account has been suspended and can't access the panel for now.
auth.suspendedOrgBody: The {org} account has been suspended and the panel can't be accessed for now.
auth.errMailNotConfigured: Email sending isn't configured. Let the administrators know.
auth.errMailFailed: The email couldn't be sent. Try again in a few minutes.
auth.welcomeSubtitle: You signed in with the temporary password from the email. Choose your own for {email}: the temporary one stops working.
auth.welcomeMfaBody: Besides your password, we'll ask for a code from your authenticator app when you sign in. It's optional and you can turn it on later from Security.
auth.welcomeMfaAdmin: As an administrator, you'll need it to manage users.
auth.welcomeMfaLater: Not now, go to the panel

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Your account at {org}: sign-in details, two-step verification and sessions.
security.profileDescription: Your name, as others see it in the panel.
security.emailDescription: You sign in and get account notices with this email.
security.emailSent: We sent a link to {email}: the change applies once you open it. Your current email gets a notice.
security.passwordDescription: Changing it signs out your other open sessions.
security.passwordChanged: Password updated. We signed out your other sessions.
security.mfaDescription: Besides your password, we'll ask for a code from your authenticator app when you sign in (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy…).
security.mfaDisableBody: You'll be able to sign in with just your password. You can turn it back on anytime.
security.mfaQrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app

security.sessionsDescription: If you left your session open on another computer or phone, close it from here.
security.othersSignedOut: Done: your other sessions were closed.

accounts.title: Users
accounts.subtitle: Panel accounts and organizations: create, edit, suspend and reactivate.
accounts.needs2fa: You need two-step verification turned on to manage accounts.
accounts.contactHint: Their email is shown on the suspended-account screen.
accounts.stepUpHint: To confirm it's you: this action grants or changes access.

accounts.suspendOrgWarning: Suspend {org}: its users won't be able to access the panel, its API will return 403 and its public forms stop taking new requests. Forms already in progress keep working.
accounts.selfNotice: This is your own account: change your details, password and 2FA from Security.
accounts.promoteWarning: An admin sees and changes every organization and can manage accounts.
accounts.stateDescription: Suspending the account cuts its panel access. On sign-in they'll see the account was suspended and who to contact.
accounts.suspendedSince: The account is suspended. Contact shown: {email}.
accounts.suspendWarning: Suspend {email}: they won't be able to access the panel until you reactivate it.
accounts.errNeeds2fa: Turn on two-step verification (Security) to manage accounts.
accounts.errLastAdmin: The panel can't be left without active administrators.
accounts.errOrgHasAdmins: This organization has active administrators: it can't be suspended.
accounts.errAdminOrgSuspended: An administrator can't belong to a suspended organization.
accounts.errOrgNameTaken: An organization with that name already exists.

accounts.errSelf: Your own account is managed from Security.
accounts.errOtherAdmin: Another administrator can only be sent a password reset link.
accounts.errTargetSuspended: The account is suspended: reactivate it first.
accounts.errPending: They haven't signed in yet: resend their access instead of sending a link.
accounts.errNotFound: We couldn't find that account or organization.
accounts.errContact: Pick an active administrator as the contact.
accounts.newAccountDescription: They get a temporary password by email to sign in through the user login (or the admin one, if admin). On first sign-in they choose their own.
accounts.linked: {email} already had a user and was linked with their existing password. If they don't remember it, send them the reset link.
accounts.errAccountExists: There's already an account with that email.
accounts.accessDescription: Email access and password reset link.
accounts.resetLinkHint: They get an email to choose a new password.
accounts.otherAdminNote: Another administrator's email can't be changed and nobody chooses their password: send them the link or a new password by email.
accounts.suspendedNote: While the account is suspended, no links are sent.
accounts.emailDescription: The one they sign in with. It changes right away, with no email confirmation: let them know. Their password stays the same.
accounts.emailPendingDescription: The access is resent to the new email with a new password; the previous one stops working.
accounts.accessSent: Account created: we sent the access to {email}.
accounts.accessPending: Access sent on {date}. Hasn't signed in yet.
accounts.accessResent: Access resent with a new password. The previous one no longer works.
accounts.cancelAccessWarning: The account for {email} is deleted and the password they received stops working.
accounts.errEmailChangedNoAccess: The email was changed, but the access couldn't be sent. Use “Resend access”.
accounts.sendAdminPasswordHint: Temporary: they get a new password by email and must change it when they sign in.
accounts.sendAdminPasswordWarning: {email} gets a new password by email: the current one stops working and their open sessions are closed. They choose their own when signing in.
accounts.errNotAdmin: This is only for administrator accounts.

clients.title: API clients
clients.subtitle: Consumers of the KYB API, identified by their API key. Issue, rotate or revoke keys, tune their rate limit and monitor usage.
clients.aiTranslationHint: Allows AI translation of this client's free-text answers. Sends applicant data to an external provider.
clients.empty: No API clients yet. Issue a key to get started.
clients.confirmRevoke: Revoke this API key? It will stop working immediately.
clients.keyOnceBody: This is the only time it is shown in clear text. Store it somewhere safe; it cannot be recovered later.

webhooks.title: Webhook endpoints
webhooks.httpsOnly: https only, port 443. Private, loopback and link-local IPs are rejected.
webhooks.empty: No endpoints yet. Register one to receive webhooks.
webhooks.secretOnceBody: This is the only time it is shown. Store it to verify the x-kyb-signature; it cannot be recovered later.
webhooks.deliveriesHint: Up to 10 staggered attempts over ~24 h. Failed ones can be resent.

integration.title: Integration configuration
integration.keyNote: Shown in full only when issued or rotated. Store it as a secret.
integration.multipleEndpoints: Multiple endpoints; the block uses the first one.
integration.endpointNote: Register a webhook endpoint below to get its ID.
integration.secretNote: Shown only when registering or rotating the endpoint.
integration.keyOnceBody: This is the only time it is shown in clear text. Store it; it cannot be recovered later.

forms.title: Forms
forms.importHint: Pick a .json file from your device or paste its content below.
forms.confirmDuplicateBody: A copy of “{name}” will be created as a draft and opened in the editor. The original form is left untouched.
forms.empty: No forms yet. Create one or import from DIDIT.
forms.confirmArchiveBody: “{name}” leaves the list and stops accepting new requests. Ones already in progress keep working. You can unarchive it at any time.
forms.confirmUnarchiveBody: “{name}” returns to the list as a draft. To make it available again you'll need to publish it.
forms.confirmDeleteBody: “{name}” will be deleted along with all its questions and translations. This action cannot be undone.
forms.confirmDeleteBodyWithRequests: “{name}” will be deleted along with all its questions and translations, and {count, plural, one {# request will be unlinked} other {# requests will be unlinked}} (they keep their own copy of the form). This action cannot be undone.
forms.errorAssignedToClient: This form is assigned to {clients}. Reassign that client before archiving or deleting it.
forms.errorRequestsNoSnapshot: {count, plural, one {# request depends} other {# requests depend}} on this form and keep no copy of its definition: deleting it would stop them from showing what the applicant filled in. Archive it instead.

builder.imageInvalidType: The file is not an image.
builder.internalNameHint: Only analysts see it: shown in the panel and in filters.
builder.publicTitleHint: Shown to the applicant above the form. Written per language.
builder.internalUseHint: Mark a short-text question as the title and an email question as the contact. Whoever fills in the form does not see these marks.
builder.internalRoleTip_title: Internal use: the answer is the request title in the panel, the report and the API. Whoever fills in the form does not see this mark.
builder.internalRoleTip_contactEmail: Internal use: the answer is the request contact email in the panel, the report and the API. Whoever fills in the form does not see this mark.
builder.internalRequiredLocked: Required: it has an internal use
builder.expiryDiditRequires: Requires the DIDIT “ID verification” review on the front of the document.
builder.expiryNoDateFields: The form has no date questions.
builder.expiryTip: This document's expiry date shows up in Expirations. Once it expires, the applicant can be asked to renew it. Whoever fills in the form does not see this mark.
builder.expiryRequiredLocked: Required: it is a document's expiry date
builder.expiryWarn_date_conditional: The date question is conditional: it may stay unanswered even if the document is uploaded, leaving no expiry date.
builder.expiryWarn_date_other_section: The date question is in another section: the person can upload the document without going through it.
builder.internalSkippable_title: This question is conditional or its section can be skipped, so it may stay unanswered. If so, the report will use the fallback title (DIDIT or the reference).
builder.internalSkippable_contactEmail: This question is conditional or its section can be skipped, so it may stay unanswered. If so, the request will have no contact email.
builder.translateHint: Translates with AI onto the draft. Review and save: machine text stays flagged.
builder.translateNothing: Nothing to translate for that language.
builder.autoTip: Machine translation, not reviewed. Edit the text to mark it as reviewed.
builder.confirmDelete: Delete this form? Its questions and translations go with it, and this cannot be undone.
builder.confirmDeleteWithRequests: Delete this form? Its questions and translations go with it, and {count, plural, one {# request will be unlinked} other {# requests will be unlinked}} (they keep their own copy). This cannot be undone.
builder.confirmDeleteField: Delete this question? This action cannot be undone.
builder.confirmDeleteSection: Delete this section and all its questions? This action cannot be undone.
builder.deleteFormHint: Irreversible. To take it off the list without losing it, archive it.
builder.confirmArchive: Archive this form? It leaves the list and stops accepting new requests; ones already in progress keep working. You can unarchive it later.
builder.presetDuplicateKeys: Some fields with existing keys were duplicated
builder.presetEmptyTargetHint: They'll be added to the first section.
builder.diditIncompatible: This review isn't compatible with the current field type
builder.diditReq_aml_screening: Apply it on the full-name question (text). It also takes from the same section, when present: date of birth, nationality, document number and entity type (person/company).
builder.diditReq_id_verification: Apply it on the file question holding the document front. The back is taken from another file question in the same section whose key contains "back" or "reverso".
builder.diditReq_proof_of_address: Apply it on the file question holding the proof of address (PDF or image).
builder.diditReq_email_verification: Requires an email-type question. No automatic verification on submit yet.
builder.diditReq_phone_verification: Requires a text question with the phone number. No automatic verification on submit yet.
builder.diditReq_database_validation: Apply it on a text question in the section with the personal data. Uses from the same section: first_name, last_name, date of birth, personal_number/CURP and issuing_state.
builder.diditReq_age_estimation: Apply it on a selfie or file question showing the person's face.
builder.diditReq_liveness: Apply it on a selfie question (camera capture).
builder.diditReq_face_match: Apply it on the selfie question. It needs a reference document: pick it below (front, optional back) or the detected front in the section is used.
builder.diditReq_kyb_registry: Apply it on the legal-name question (text). The country (required) and the registration number are picked in this popover; when left on "Automatic", they are detected from other questions' key names.
builder.kybNoCountryWarning: The form has no country question. Add one (country type) or pick it here — without a country the registry validation cannot run.
builder.kybDuplicateWarning: An earlier question already carries the company validation: only the first one in the form runs. Remove this review or the other one.
builder.kybRegNumberIsNumber: The registration number question is a Number field: it drops leading zeros and may not match the registry. Change it to Short text.

admin.kybRunError: Could not run the registry validation.
admin.kybSearchByName: Search by name (always goes through review)
admin.kybMissingCountry: Country missing — the search cannot run.

admin.kybErrorRetry: The search failed and can be retried (a failed search is not billed).
admin.kybPreliminaryHint: DIDIT is confirming these with the registry (~1–2 min). Selection becomes available once the search resolves.
admin.kybBlocked_NAME_ONLY_MATCH: Name-only search: automatic selection is blocked and requires human review.
admin.kybBlocked_NO_EXACT_REGISTRATION_MATCH: No candidate exactly matches the declared registration number.
admin.kybBlocked_MULTIPLE_EXACT_MATCHES: Several candidates share the declared registration number.
admin.kybBlocked_CANDIDATE_NOT_FETCHABLE: The exact-number candidate is not available for retrieval.
admin.kybCandidatesHint: The search returned candidate companies. Select the right one; fetching the full profile is a billable operation.
admin.kybNoCandidates: The search found no companies in the registry.
admin.kybConfirmSelect: This action will request the full company profile from DIDIT and may incur a charge. The selection cannot be undone. Continue?
admin.kybNoneMatchedInfo: The analyst marked that no candidate corresponds to the declared company.
admin.kybAttemptedInfo: Select requested — outcome uncertain. Check the DIDIT console for an existing session; it will not be retried automatically.
admin.kybSuperseded: Cycle superseded by a newer search.
admin.documentsOtherHint: No matching question in the current definition
admin.docNoPreview: This file type can't be previewed.

aiUsage.estimateWarning: Costs on this screen are ESTIMATES: they use the rate configured below and do not account for cache discounts, provider price changes, or taxes. For actual spend and remaining balance, check your AI provider dashboard:
aiUsage.subtitleMember: AI translations and DIDIT checks of your organization.
aiUsage.diditHint: What DIDIT charged for the form verifications. DIDIT reports the amount of each verification; values marked ≈ are estimates using its public rate.

aiUsage.diditBalanceLow: Low balance: enough for only a few verifications
aiUsage.estimatedLegend: ≈ estimated with DIDIT's public rate. Company validation doesn't report its cost: selection costs US$ 2.00 and search US$ 0.50, charged only if DIDIT resolves it with a paid source.
